speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs whether there are any regulations that prohibit mothers from breastfeeding their children in public.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: It is not possible to be more specific than that.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: To determine if any offences might be made out, Police would need to ascertain the specific facts of each case and the circumstances.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: She said they are generally not going to be prosecuted, if I am right to say that.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: So, could I just ask specifically, whether a mother who is breastfeeding her baby in the public without a cover – would that be liable to prosecution?
